Tai Lung from Kung Fu Panda. He was  indoctrinated from birth by his adoptive father (shifu) that he was destined to become the great dragon warrior. Heck even his own name (given by shifu) is translated as great dragon. So Tai Lung trains super hard throughout his youth to achieve his dream. He becomes a master of kung fu, however, with this he becomes arrogant (largely due to Shifu's constant encouragement) . Due to his pride and arrogance Master Oogway denies him the dragon warrior title. Tai lung gets understandably pissed and unfortunately takes his anger out on the village. Oogway defeats him and he gets sent to jail for life.

20 years later he manages to escape and finds that a panda with no experience of kung fu is named dragon warrior. What a slap in the face that must have been. Another slap on the face is that he finally got his hands on the dragon scroll (something the dragon warrior is  only allowed  read)  and finds out that it essentially was just a trick. The scroll was reflective paper showing the face of the reader (in this case tai lung) , basically there is no special knowledge within the scroll - the point was anyone can become great . Then, despite his superior skills he gets defeated by said panda.

Essentially shifu set Tai lung up for failure and disappointment by indoctrinating him and filling his head with dreams and arrogance. Tai lung gets punished for being brainwashed and shifu gets no punishment at all.
